subject.title: fix: retry Signal session init conflicts

question: Should this PR become the canonical Signal retry fix for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/100944 after live proof and focused side-effect coverage are added?
rationale: The implementation shape is source-supported, but this external PR changes message delivery, overlaps other open candidate PRs, and a maintainer has already called for dedicated review and live Signal proof on the same fix shape.

options.title: Keep This As Candidate After Proof
options.body: Keep this branch open and require redacted live Signal/gateway proof plus focused retry-cap, non-retryable, same-key ordering, and duplicate-side-effect coverage before merge.

options.title: Consolidate On Another Candidate
options.body: Use another open Signal retry PR as canonical if it becomes cleaner, proof-positive, and mergeable first, then close duplicate branches after that path is settled.

options.title: Accept Unit-Only Proof Risk
options.body: Maintainers may explicitly accept the current mocked test evidence, but they would own the remaining real Signal delivery risk.

recommendation.title: Keep This As Candidate After Proof
recommendation.body: Keep this branch open and require redacted live Signal/gateway proof plus focused retry-cap, non-retryable, same-key ordering, and duplicate-side-effect coverage before merge.
